review_candidates.title: Desktop Support Analyst - Field
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Responsibilities Include but are not limited to Provide timely technical support to employees in person, by telephone, through email, and using approved remote-support tools. Install, configure, maintain, repair, and replace approved desktop hardware, software, and peripheral equipment. Document support requests, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and escalations in the Company help desk system. Maintain accurate hardware and software inventory records and assist with software-license track
